story_text: As a guest, I want the system to reject an invalid date format so that only correctly formatted dates are accepted.

positive.title: Booking with correctly formatted check-in and check-out dates
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Click submit

negative.title: Booking with check-in date uses an invalid format
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Fill the check-in date field with an invalid format
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: An error message regarding an incorrect date format

negative.title: Booking with check-out date uses an invalid format
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Fill the check-out date field with an invalid format
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: An error message regarding an incorrect date format

negative.title: Correct error message is returned for invalid date format
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Fill the check-in date field with an invalid format
4. Click submit
5. Validate the error message
negative.expected_result: An error message regarding an incorrect date format

edge.title: Booking with date as a plain text string
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Fill the date fields with plain strings
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error message regarding an incorrect date format

edge.title: Booking with date field containing numbers only
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Fill the date fields with numbers only
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error message regarding an incorrect date format

edge.title: Booking with date using correct values but wrong separator
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Fill the date fields with correct values but different separators
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error message regarding an incorrect date format

edge.title: Booking with date field as null
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill All the Required fields with valid data
3. Leave the date fields empty
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error message regarding an incorrect date format
